# UIMS — Unified IT Management System

> Enterprise-Grade Centralized IT Operations Platform: Hardware Fleet, SaaS Subscriptions, Directory IAM, Network IPAM, Stockroom Inventory, and Helpdesk Incident Management.
> Monorepo (pnpm + Turborepo), React 19 + Ant Design 6, NestJS 11 + Prisma 7 ORM, PostgreSQL 17, Redis 8, Nginx TLS on Port 5679.

## Core Documentation

- [Full LLM Specification & API Reference](file:///home/user/projects/uims/llms-full.txt): Complete technical reference, database schemas, full REST endpoints, frontend standards, security matrices, and infrastructure topology.
- [AI Development & Agent Guidelines](file:///home/user/projects/uims/agents.md): Development protocols, language policies, Ant Design 6 conventions, and monorepo workflow.
- [System Architecture](file:///home/user/projects/uims/.planning/codebase/ARCHITECTURE.md): Modular monolith architecture, presentation layer, services, data access layer, and interceptors.
- [Technology Stack](file:///home/user/projects/uims/.planning/codebase/STACK.md): Monorepo packages, libraries, runtime environments, and engine versions.
- [Directory Structure](file:///home/user/projects/uims/.planning/codebase/STRUCTURE.md): Monorepo tree breakdown, components, pages, stores, services, and modules.
- [Development Conventions](file:///home/user/projects/uims/.planning/codebase/CONVENTIONS.md): Code style, naming rules, response envelopes, error handling, and testing patterns.
- [External Integrations](file:///home/user/projects/uims/.planning/codebase/INTEGRATIONS.md): PostgreSQL, Redis, SeaweedFS, MeiliSearch, and Nginx proxy configs.
- [Security & Concerns](file:///home/user/projects/uims/.planning/codebase/CONCERNS.md): RBAC, JWT security, TLS termination, audit logging, and SOC2 compliance.

## Key Infrastructure & Access

- **Web UI (Nginx HTTPS)**: `https://localhost:5679` (Direct Public TLS 1.2/1.3)
- **API Backend (NestJS)**: `http://localhost:3002` (Internally port 3000, proxied via Nginx at `/api/v1/*`)
- **Database (PostgreSQL 17)**: `localhost:5433` (DB: `uims_db`, User: `uims`)
- **Cache & Queue (Redis 8)**: `localhost:6381`
- **Search Engine (MeiliSearch)**: `http://localhost:7700`
- **Object Storage (SeaweedFS)**: `http://localhost:8333` (S3 Filer)

## Quick CLI Reference

- `pnpm dev` — Start full stack in local development
- `pnpm build` — Compile all monorepo apps and packages
- `pnpm lint` — Run Biome linter
- `pnpm format` — Format all source files with Biome
- `pnpm test` — Run automated test suites
- `pnpm db:migrate` — Apply Prisma database migrations
- `pnpm db:seed` — Populate database with default seeds
- `pnpm docker:up` — Start all infrastructure containers
